note: the MPU stack guard (CONFIG_MPU_STACK_GUARD=y on the Cortex-M7, decision 0023) takes nothing from the stack buffer: without CONFIG_USERSPACE K_THREAD_STACK_DEFINE is K_KERNEL_STACK_DEFINE (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/include/zephyr/kernel/thread_stack.h#L457), whose object adds K_KERNEL_STACK_RESERVED = ARCH_KERNEL_STACK_RESERVED = MPU_GUARD_ALIGN_AND_SIZE below the buffer (thread_stack.h#L97, https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/include/zephyr/arch/arm/arch.h#L266-L271), and the guard region is programmed at stack_info.start - guard_size (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/arch/arm/core/mpu/arm_core_mpu.c#L322), outside the buffer; the object's size and alignment are checked at step 10. CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL and CONFIG_STACK_POINTER_RANDOM are unset
